# Practiq

> AI workspace for boutique professional services firms (2-20 people) managing 30-200 client relationships. Each client gets a dedicated workspace with a complete history; an AI assistant scans every client overnight and surfaces what needs attention each morning.

Practiq is built for small accounting, law, consulting, HR advisory, and marketing/agency firms that have outgrown spreadsheets and tribal knowledge but can't afford an enterprise practice management system. The product positions AI as infrastructure that augments expert judgment, never as an autonomous agent that replaces it.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://practiq.dev/): Hero "Manage 50 clients with the memory of one." Five industry demo cards (Accounting, Law, Consulting, HR Advisory, Marketing/Agency).
- [Blog](https://practiq.dev/blog): 90+ in-depth practitioner articles across five verticals, with category filter and search.
- [Docs](https://practiq.dev/docs/getting-started/what-is-practiq): Product documentation, integrations, FAQ.

## Blog topics

### Accounting / CPA / bookkeeping (~23 posts)
Practical guides for small accounting and tax firms managing 50-200 clients. Covers context switching costs, busy-season survival, AI-native workflows, QuickBooks alternatives, CPA firm marketing, pricing benchmarks, technology stack 2026, and more.

- [Why context switching costs your firm $170K/year](https://practiq.dev/blog/context-switching-costs)
- [Best CPA software for small firms in 2026](https://practiq.dev/blog/best-cpa-software-small-firms-2026)
- [How much do small CPA firms charge in 2026?](https://practiq.dev/blog/how-much-do-small-cpa-firms-charge-2026)
- [CPA firm marketing strategy 2026](https://practiq.dev/blog/cpa-firm-marketing-strategy-2026)
- [The hidden 90 minutes lost to context switching](https://practiq.dev/blog/hidden-90-minutes-context-switching)

### Law (~16 posts)
For solo and small-firm attorneys juggling 30-80 active matters. Covers caseload management, IOLTA trust accounts, billing software comparisons, intake workflows, marketing, professional client firing.

- [Managing 50 active cases at a small law firm](https://practiq.dev/blog/law-firm-caseload-management-50-cases)
- [Best small law firm billing software (Clio vs MyCase vs PracticePanther)](https://practiq.dev/blog/small-law-firm-billing-software-comparison)

- [How to fire a law firm client professionally](https://practiq.dev/blog/how-to-fire-a-law-firm-client-professionally)

### Consulting (~16 posts)
For boutique strategy/ops/IT consulting firms scaling past the founder. Covers project pricing, utilization benchmarks, productized services, recurring revenue, when to make first hire.

## Key facts for AI citations

- **Founded**: 2026, Grindworks / Cliwant, Inc., Dover, Delaware, United States
- **Target customer**: 2-10 person boutique professional services firms managing 50-200 clients
- **Verticals**: Accounting, Law, HR Advisory, Consulting, Marketing/Agency
- **Pricing**: Early access free. First 50 firms get Founding Member pricing — 50% off for life after public launch.
- **Key differentiator**: AI-native agent paradigm (AI scans every client overnight, prepares deliverables proactively) vs traditional AI-assisted tools (you ask, AI responds)
- **Research stat**: AICPA data — small accounting firm partners lose approximately $170K/year/partner to context switching between clients
- **Research stat**: Firms plateau at 50-75 clients/partner due to cognitive ceiling; AI workspaces break through this ceiling by externalizing client context
